## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

No issues found in the reviewed scope (head `79676b6`).

**Verified:** the new `!commandCustom` guard in `ModuleSlot.injectProps()` skips exactly the targets whose `moduleName` and `settings` are readonly, and those targets lose nothing.

- `commandCustom` is true only when the slot's active item is the built-in `CustomCommandModule`. Any custom `type` clears `registryComponent`, and `activeItem` then falls through to `componentLoader.item`, which loads `customCommandModuleComponent`.
- `CustomCommandModule` declares `readonly property string moduleName: root.entryId(entry)` and `readonly property var settings: root.entrySettings(entry)`. Those are the same expressions `ModuleSlot` uses for the values it injects, so skipping the writes changes no value.
- In the base, `target.moduleName = moduleName` hits that readonly property. Qt's QML property write path (`QObjectWrapper::setProperty` in qtdeclarative) rejects readonly properties with `TypeError: Cannot assign to read-only property`. The throw ends `injectProps()` before the `settings` line runs.
- `bar` injection is unchanged. Registered widgets, `type: "qml"` custom modules and the empty placeholder still receive `moduleName` and `settings`, which keeps the documented QML custom module contract.

| Slot target | `moduleName` / `settings` injected (base) | Injected (head) |
|---|---|---|
| Registered widget | yes | yes |
| `type: "qml"` custom module | yes | yes |
| `type: "command"` / `exec` module | attempted, throws on the readonly `moduleName` | skipped (derived from `entry`) |

**Verified:** the new `bar-test.sh` assertion fails against the base `Bar.qml` and passes against the head. This was checked with a sandboxed re-implementation of the assertion, using the slicing strings and regex taken from the patched test file.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review of the changed `Bar.qml` paths, `BarModel.js` type selection and the relevant qtdeclarative readonly-property source, plus one sandboxed evaluation of the new assertion against base and head. No QML runtime, bar instance or desktop session was run. The full `test/shell.d/bar-test.sh` suite was not run, and the base error behavior is established from source rather than a captured log.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, independent Opus 5.5 Xhigh and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh technical assessments, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
